The battle hood is a reward that can be purchased with tokens from the Fist of Guthix minigame.
Like all other armours obtained from the Fist of Guthix minigame, it can be degraded for trading purposes by talking to Reggie in the cave and asking him to degrade the item.
A bird's nest can be found while cutting trees, collected from the Managing Miscellania minigame, as a reward from an Evil Tree and sometimes as a reward in the Gnome Restaurant minigame.
Bob shirts are shirts depicting Bob the Jagex Cat and are obtained from easy Treasure Trails.

Chores is a quest item that players obtain from Bob the Jagex Cat as part of A Tail of Two Cats.

The Cramulet is an amulet made by the player after the Do No Evil quest by combining the Cramulet with the Camulet.
Dropping all cramulets and cat speak amulets will allow you to obtain a new one from the Sphinx and then pick the old ones up from the ground.
The blueprints for the master farmer outfit must first be purchased from Granny Potterington at the Farmers' Market for 1,000 beans.
They can be traded, but only for other master farmer outfit pieces.

Crown of Legends.x: The Crown of Legends is a cosmetic override available to past seasonal hiscores winners. A Crown of Supremacy turns into a Crown of Legends after the duration of the hiscore has surpassed.

The 'Graceful' version is unlocked by completing tier 54 of Forinthry Frontier, and the 'Elegant' version could be purchased from the Yak Coin Shop for 4 Yak Coins during the event.

sc: Lunar shards are items that could be won from Lunarfury Armour, a Treasure Hunter promotion, or created by combining 1,000 lunar spheres during the promotion period from 5 to 10 April 2017.
Lunar staff - pt3 is made by using a dramen staff on the Air altar, Fire altar and Water altar (in that order) during the Lunar Diplomacy quest.
After the quest is complete lunar staves can no longer be made through this process.

Lunarfury (Tier 2) Maul.x: The Lunarfury (Tier 2) Maul is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that is part of the Lunarfury (Tier 2) outfit. It can be obtained by upgrading the Lunarfury (Tier 1) set and having the Lunarfury (Tier 1) Maul unlocked.

sc: The Mask of the Green Wyrm is a slayer mask obtained from the Shattered Worlds Reward Shop for 21 million anima.
Before a higher tier can be bought, previous tiers must also be bought.

Master crafter trousers.x: The master crafter trousers are a cosmetic override that can be purchased for 5,000 oddments on a rotational basis in the Marketplace alongside the other pieces of the master crafter outfit. It was originally a reward from the Master Crafting time-limited event. Players could earn it by handing in 11,500 master crafting patches to the Master Crafter.

Mighty slayer helmet (blue).x: The blue mighty slayer helmet is a level 70 slayer helmet with bonuses equivalent to a hybrid barrows helmet. It is made by upgrading a strong slayer helmet for 600 Slayer points at any Slayer Master, although subsequent upgrades will only cost 60 Slayer points.

sc: It can be made at a forge and anvil using 3 mithril bars and a mithril plateskirt, requiring 960 progress to complete, granting a total of 360 Smithing experience.

Necturion Off-hand Scimitar.x: The Necturion Off-hand Scimitar is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that is part of the Necturion Outfit. Along with the rest of the outfit, it can be unlocked by spending 100% respect in the Artisans' Workshop.

sc: The novite plateskirt is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.

They are obtained from ogre coffins, which will often break lockpicks and decrease players' Thieving abilities upon opening using thieving methods.
They can also be obtained by looting a zombie impling jar (zombie implings require level 87 Hunter to catch).

Replica GWD (Pernix) Cowl.x: The Replica GWD (Pernix) Cowl is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Replica GWD (Pernix) outfit.

The Scroll is given to the player by King Vargas during Royal Trouble.

It is made by using a knife (from the inventory or tool belt) on seeping elm branches.
It can be created by combining 3,600 shark fragments.
They can be traded, but only for other parts.
Square sandwich is a food item that can be bought from the Sandwich lady's bakery.
The square sandwich was one of several food items that could be obtained from the sandwich lady random event.

sc: The team-27 cape is a wilderness cape that can be purchased for 50 coins from Neil.
